notes.title: Version 1.2 - Small Optimizations and MacOS Launch option!
notes.content:
Changed the menu screen similar to how the bootleg Russian translation did (which exists, for some reason), bringing the file-size down from ~800MB to ~265MB.
[i][strike]Please don't ask me how that's possible, it's embarrassing.[/strike][/i]

Changes to the looping audio were made, which should make the looping transition smoother.

Launching the game via Steam Launcher on MacOS should now be possible.
[i]I have no way of testing Mac [strike]or Linux[/strike] launch though.[/i]

Thank you all for your support, and have a good one.
[i]~Medice[/i]

notes.title: Version 1.1 - JP Translation is live!
notes.content:
A Japanese Localization courtesy of volunteer Translator [url=https://twitter.com/Idioteque3389]ichisan[/url] has been added to the game.
Thanks to him, more people will hopefully be able to enjoy my story, which is great!

Very minor UI and Menu changes have also been made.

Truly, thank you all for your support, and have a good one.
[i]~Medice[/i]
